name: Goblin Base · Courtyard
_design: Goblin Base lower-left world region. Generated by tools/maps/build_goblin_base.gd. Original goblin_arena_b combat bounds, solids, spawn/portal and monster composition retained. Supplied gobbin_base.fbx scenery kit, no Orc kit.
_arena: Floating-island board, LANDSCAPE (Boss 2026-11-10: TFT-like): 16 x 9 m. Our squad of 3 starts in a column on the left (player_spawns), monsters on the right: melee in front, archers/mages behind, a boss in the middle. No obstacles. The scene's own ground/props are hidden and client/arena_props.gd builds the island (tile board, rim, rock underside, clouds, sky). The camera frames the whole island and can zoom in on the fighters. (A portrait board was tried and dropped: too top-down.)
